source_coverage: PDF pages 164–168 / printed 163–167; primary White Beryl ff.196a–205b; embedded Moonbeams f.24a–24b
study_boundaries: Father's CURRENT trigram and contemporaneous birth incident are extra-natal inputs
Planetary conjunction names are a formal traditional algorithm, not observed sky conjunctions
All birth and sex conditions require independent pre-score input freeze
Historical danger/ritual claims must not be interpreted as medical or safety guidance

source_notes.paraphrase: This prognostic method combines the father's trigram current at delivery with incidental events happening at the birth. It is not a pure natal chart and requires independently witnessed context.
source_notes.source_kind: Gyurme Dorje 2001 English rendering/analysis of White Beryl and Moonbeams; Tibetan original not independently collated

source_notes.paraphrase: A case combining the father's current Li trigram, twin daughters, an animal-year condition and a gathering of paternal relatives is assigned an adverse twin-survival prognosis and ritual prescription.
source_notes.source_kind: Gyurme Dorje 2001 English rendering/analysis of White Beryl and Moonbeams; Tibetan original not independently collated

source_notes.paraphrase: Father's current Khon trigram combined with birth in a sheep year, quarrelling and father-in-law presence is assigned an adverse birth omen, together with a proposed stupa/ritual remedy.
source_notes.source_kind: Gyurme Dorje 2001 English rendering/analysis of White Beryl and Moonbeams; Tibetan original not independently collated

source_notes.paraphrase: Father's current Dva trigram, child's bird/monkey year and a contemporaneous blood feud or gathering of weapons are associated with an unfavorable health-and-conflict omen.
source_notes.source_kind: Gyurme Dorje 2001 English rendering/analysis of White Beryl and Moonbeams; Tibetan original not independently collated

source_notes.paraphrase: Father's current Khen trigram with a sworn oath (especially involving an iron-dog-year person) is assigned an omen of impaired family continuity or decline.
source_notes.source_kind: Gyurme Dorje 2001 English rendering/analysis of White Beryl and Moonbeams; Tibetan original not independently collated

source_notes.paraphrase: Father's current Kham trigram with birth outside marriage or incest, especially another household member's mother-relationship year, is linked to hostility within the household; a ritual remedy is proposed.
source_notes.source_kind: Gyurme Dorje 2001 English rendering/analysis of White Beryl and Moonbeams; Tibetan original not independently collated

source_notes.paraphrase: Father's current Gin trigram plus a birth coinciding with scattered bones (especially those of an ox-year monk) is interpreted as an obstacle concerning resources and ancestral relations.
source_notes.source_kind: Gyurme Dorje 2001 English rendering/analysis of White Beryl and Moonbeams; Tibetan original not independently collated

source_notes.paraphrase: Father's current Zin trigram with birth of a daughter is associated with an omen concerning the continuity of the paternal family line; no independent evidence of the claim is supplied.
source_notes.source_kind: Gyurme Dorje 2001 English rendering/analysis of White Beryl and Moonbeams; Tibetan original not independently collated

source_notes.paraphrase: Father's current Zon trigram with burning or overflowing cooking vessels at birth is associated with a transfer of distinction from brother to sister and unfavorable household omens.
source_notes.source_kind: Gyurme Dorje 2001 English rendering/analysis of White Beryl and Moonbeams; Tibetan original not independently collated

source_notes.paraphrase: The text's so-called major triple planetary conjunction uses combined destiny element, year-sign and trigram, differentiated by subject sex. Its lesser variant has only year-sign/trigram concordance without matching destiny element. This is a symbolic classification, not an observed ephemeris event.
source_notes.source_kind: Gyurme Dorje 2001 English rendering/analysis of White Beryl and Moonbeams; Tibetan original not independently collated

source_notes.paraphrase: Moonbeams f.24a presents male/female conditional combinations for Saturn, Mars, Jupiter and Mercury named conjunctions (fully transcribed as a separate T08 lookup). Planet labels do not imply the indicated planets share astronomical longitude.
source_notes.source_kind: Gyurme Dorje 2001 English rendering/analysis of White Beryl and Moonbeams; Tibetan original not independently collated

source_notes.paraphrase: The text attaches differentiated life-course assertions to Mars, Jupiter, Saturn and Mercury triple configurations, including combinations of resource loss, later recovery, hazards and social consequences. These assertions are textual, not observationally demonstrated.
source_notes.source_kind: Gyurme Dorje 2001 English rendering/analysis of White Beryl and Moonbeams; Tibetan original not independently collated

source_notes.paraphrase: This planetary-luck chart has nine pebbles: outer destiny, intermediate vitality, inner constitutional type, plus all six ordered positive/negative comparisons across the three positions. Each direction is distinct.
source_notes.source_kind: Gyurme Dorje 2001 English rendering/analysis of White Beryl and Moonbeams; Tibetan original not independently collated

source_notes.paraphrase: An independent scheme determines a child's planetary luck from the mother's natal year-sign, trigram and attained age at birth (15–50 in the presented table), then the child's year animal. A compatible grouping is named a triple planetary alliance; other child groups receive different classes.
source_notes.source_kind: Gyurme Dorje 2001 English rendering/analysis of White Beryl and Moonbeams; Tibetan original not independently collated

source_notes.paraphrase: For mothers of five enumerated year-elements/signs with maternal trigram Zin, maternal ages 15,23,31,39,47 paired with a child in tiger/horse/dog year form a Triple Saturn Alliance with asserted family continuity and long-life prognosis.
source_notes.source_kind: Gyurme Dorje 2001 English rendering/analysis of White Beryl and Moonbeams; Tibetan original not independently collated

source_notes.paraphrase: Plate 4 fig.7 provides eight maternal-trigram columns for every mother age from 15 through 50, each identifying eligible maternal natal year-signs, child's compatible animal trine and resulting symbolic Saturn/Jupiter/Mars/Mercury alliance; other trines produce distinct pair labels.
source_notes.source_kind: Gyurme Dorje 2001 English rendering/analysis of White Beryl and Moonbeams; Tibetan original not independently collated
